title: The WalkUp: a concept site for the bar upstairs
tag: Concept site · cocktail bar, Cary, NC
summaryLead: A concept site for a cocktail bar one flight up in downtown Cary. Not a launched project.
summaryMore: One hand-written HTML file in night ink and sign-painter gold, built around the climb.

stack.name: Delivery
stack.detail: One self-contained HTML file with embedded WebP photos. No framework or build step.

stack.name: Accessibility
stack.detail: HTML5 landmarks and ARIA tabs with arrow-key support.

stack.name: Type
stack.detail: Big Shoulders Display, Newsreader and Lekton.

stack.name: Interaction
stack.detail: Menu and running tab, scroll staircase, draggable review reel. Skipped for reduced motion.

stack.name: Brand assets
stack.detail: Logo traced into one reusable SVG symbol.

stack.name: Forms
stack.detail: Sign-up is front-end only in this concept.

chapters.title: The stairs, built into the scroll
chapters.challenge: First-timers walk past the door because it is upstairs.
chapters.solution: A 14-step staircase fills with gold as you scroll.
chapters.outcome: Guests remember that it is upstairs.

chapters.title: A menu you can plan a round with
chapters.challenge: 49 items change seasonally, and guests order at the counter.
chapters.solution: Menu data in tabs, with a running tab that slides up.
chapters.outcome: Easy to update one line at a time.

chapters.title: A logo that holds up at any size
chapters.challenge: The only logo file was a soft 560-pixel image.
chapters.solution: Traced into vector SVG symbols reused across the page.
chapters.outcome: Crisp from the nav mark to the footer.

results.title: The building, explained
results.text: The first screen, nav and scroll all say it is upstairs.

results.title: Built from the room
results.text: The palette and type come from the sign and brick.

results.title: Motion that respects people
results.text: Logo reveal and parallax are skipped for reduced motion.
